tha-ap497:1.1: Upaḍḍhadussadāyaka.] Padumuttarassa bhagavato Sujāto nāma sāvako / paṃsukūlaṃ gavesanto saṅkāre carate sadā. // //
tha-ap497:2.1: Nagare Haṃsavatiyā paresaṃ bhatako ahaṃ / upaḍḍhadussaṃ datvāṇa sirasā abhivādayiṃ. // //
tha-ap497:3.1: Tena kammena sukatena cetanāpaṇidhīhi ca / jahitvā mānusaṃ dehaṃ Tāvatiṃsaṃ agacch' ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap497:4.1: Tettiṃsakkhattuṃ devindo devarajjam akārayiṃ / sattasattatikkhattuñ ca cakkavatti ahos' ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap497:5.1: Padesarajjaṃ vipulaṃ gaṇanāto asaṅkhiyaṃ / upaḍḍhadussadānena modāmi akutobhayo. // //
tha-ap497:6.1: Icchamāno c' ahaṃ ajja sakānanaṃ sapabbataṃ / khomadussehi chādeyyaṃ aḍḍhadussass' idaṃ phalaṃ // //
tha-ap497:7.1: Satasahasse ito kappe yaṃ dānam adadiṃ tadā / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi aḍḍhadussass' idaṃ phalaṃ.
tha-ap497:11.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Upaḍḍhadussadāyako th. i. g. a-ti.
